//: Allowlist for arc-register.yml. A dispatched arc-register request is honored ONLY if `repo` is an exact key here. The repo-url and scale_set_name used for the actual `helm upgrade --install` come from THIS config entry, never from the dispatch payload — repository_dispatch carries no cryptographically-verifiable sender-repo field (the dispatching PAT's github.actor is the human token owner, identical across every consumer repo on a personal-account org), so the payload's `repo` claim cannot be trusted on its own. Binding the real registration target to a version-controlled config entry means a forged/typo'd `repo` string can, at worst, name a DIFFERENT allowlisted repo (auditable in git history) — it can never point registration at an arbitrary non-allowlisted target. Onboarding a new repo is a PR here, reviewed like any other config change.
